summary_1line: Krishna praises Narada’s virtues as universally beloved; Yudhishthira then asks Bhishma about cosmic origins, time, and the life cycles of beings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna speaks in Ugrasena’s court while courtiers listen as he lists the many virtues of the serene sage Narada.
The wandering sage Narada with veena in hand moves calmly among diverse people, blessing all without attachment or pride.
Yudhishthira sits respectfully before the aged Bhishma on his bed of arrows, asking about the origin and end of all creatures.
